narratives.author: claude
narratives.headline: Seven-game Sunday, five Pass-grade unders, and the injury reports still to come
narratives.briefing: It is a 7-game Sunday with every game still to tip and no prop clearing the Pass grade: the five picks carry conviction between 30 and 38, so treat this as a thin board. The edge, such as it is, sits in rebound and assist unders where the simulation is well ahead of DraftKings, most clearly Josh Giddey at 72% in sims against a 50% market price. Every card is already past its play-to, so the opening prices are gone and patience at the listed numbers matters more than chasing. The record argues for caution: the morning report is 7-12-0 (-5.78u) and game lines are 17-36 (-20.74u) since 2026-11-11, although morning picks have seen the closing line move toward them 12 times and against them 6. This edition is written before injury reports are final; we are waiting on Norman Powell and Jalen Smith for Chicago, Kingston Flemings for Atlanta and Cade Cunningham for Detroit, and any change there re-prices the cards on the next run.

cards.p|4871145|reb|Under: The simulation has Giddey under 6.5 in 72% of games with a 5.4 average, the projection is 5, and DEN is #8 toughest of 30 on point guard rebounds. What makes us wrong is Caleb Wilson being out: his usage jumps 17% to 22% without him, and the overs came when he played long, 31.5 minutes against a 23.8 projection tonight.
cards.p|4711294|reb|Under: Buzelis has stayed under 5.5 in 8 of his last 10 and the sim lands at 4.9, with a 4.5 projection. The risk is a thin margin, with 6 of his last 10 finishing within 1 of the number, plus a +30% bump without Wilson; at −130 there is little room for a bad bounce.
cards.p|4869342|ast|Under: DET is #1 toughest of 30 on point guard assists and the sim has Daniels under in 60% of games, helped by a 40% blowout rate. Against it: he is averaging 6.5 assists over his last 10, the projection of 5.6 sits above the line, and the market has out-predicted the model on assists this season (83-113 when that reason argued against), so this one leans heavily on the price.
cards.p|4431680|reb|Under: The projection of 6.6 is under 7.5 and his history against DET is 2.8 rebounds a game in 4 meetings, but the sim is only 50% and he has gone under 7.5 just 3 of his last 10 while averaging 9. This is the weakest-supported card on the board; Flemings's status matters for how Atlanta's minutes shake out.
cards.p|5160992|reb|Under: The projection of 5.1 and a 61% sim rate support the under, and his recent trend is improving. The worry is that he is averaging 7.4 over his last 10 and only 3 of those went under; if his minutes run long, as in the overs at 27.8, the number is in danger.

narratives.leans_note: The five game-line leans, led by DAL -1.5 at 57% in sims against 51% at DraftKings, are leans only; game lines are 17-36 since 2026-11-11 and nothing here is a best bet.
